code.content:
def parse_line(line):
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) != 10:
        raise ValueError("Invalid log line format")
    
    ip = parts[0]
    time = parts[3][1:-1]
    request = parts[5][1:-1]
    method, path = request.split()
    status = int(parts[8])
    bytes_str = parts[9]
    bytes_ = int(bytes_str) if bytes_str != "-" else 0
    seconds = float(parts[7])
    
    return {
        "ip": ip,
        "time": time,
        "method": method,
        "path": path,
        "status": status,
        "bytes": bytes_,
        "seconds": seconds
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Add assertions here to test the parse_line function
    pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Add assertions here to test the parse_line function
    test_line = '127.0.0.1 - - [10/Oct/2023:13:55:36 +0000] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 2326 0.045'
    expected_output = {
        "ip": "127.0.0.1",
        "time": "10/Oct/2023:13:55:36 +0000",
        "method": "GET",
        "path": "/index.html",
        "status": 200,
        "bytes": 2326,
        "seconds": 0.045
    }
    assert parse_line(test_line) == expected_output, "Test failed"
    print("Test passed")
